To: Midnight of 9 January 2027

Plot 66, GIDC Makarpura, Vadodara 390010 (Factory, warehouse and office premises), being the only location covered under this policy.
Construction: RCC frame, with GI sheet roofing for the shed. Occupancy: Manufacturing and warehousing. Fire protection: Hydrant system, 64 portable extinguishers, sprinkler in warehouse, fire alarm.

Premium received on: 5 January 2026, through NEFT, Receipt No. R/26/011742

6. PERILS COVERED

Section I: Fire; lightning; explosion or implosion (boilers excluded); aircraft damage; riot, strike, malicious damage; storm, cyclone, typhoon, tempest, hurricane, tornado, flood and inundation; impact damage; subsidence and landslide including rockfall; bursting or overflowing of water tanks, apparatus and pipes; missile testing operations; leakage from automatic sprinkler installations; bush fire.

Section II: Loss or damage to the stock, as a result of burglary or housebreaking, where there is actual forcible and violent entry into or exit from the premises, and hold-up or theft following such forcible entry.

7. EXCESS (DEDUCTIBLE)

Section I - Fire: 5% of the claim amount, subject to a minimum of Rs 25,000 for each and every loss.
Section I - Special perils (STFI, flood, earthquake): 10% of the claim amount, subject to a minimum of Rs 50,000 for each and every loss.
Section II - Burglary: 10% of the claim amount, subject to a minimum of Rs 10,000 for each and every loss.

8. EXCLUSIONS (SUMMARY)

The following are excluded from cover:
(a) loss or damage by war, invasion, act of foreign enemy, civil war, mutiny, military or usurped power, nuclear and radiation hazards;
(b) loss or damage caused by earthquake, fire-shock and volcanic eruption (unless the Earthquake extension is taken, which has not been taken in this policy);
(c) loss or damage to property by its own spontaneous combustion, fermentation, or heating, or by the process of heating or drying;
(d) loss of or damage to stocks in cold storage, and to precious stones, bullion, cash, currency notes, securities, documents, manuscripts, plans and drawings;
(e) consequential loss, loss of profits, loss of rent or any other indirect loss of any kind;
(f) loss or damage arising from theft, dishonesty or fraud by the employees of the Insured or members of their families, or collusion with them, in Section II;
(g) loss or damage in Section II where there is no visible mark of forcible entry or exit, or loss by mysterious disappearance or shortage found only at stock-taking;
(h) loss or damage to property that is not situated at the location stated in the policy, or in transit;
(i) loss or damage to electrical machines or apparatus caused by overrunning, excessive pressure, short circuit, arcing, self-heating or leakage of electricity, unless fire ensues;
(j) loss or damage as a result of terrorism, except where cover has been specifically purchased;
(k) losses occurring when the premises remain unoccupied for more than thirty (30) consecutive days without the insurer's prior consent.

9. CLAIM PROCEDURE AND INTIMATION

9.1 In the event of any loss or damage, the Insured shall, immediately, and in any case within forty-eight (48) hours of the occurrence or discovery of the loss, give written notice to the Insurer at the Vadodara Claims Cell (email: claims.vadodara@bharatshield.example) and to the Insurer's toll-free claims helpline 1800-000-0000. Delayed intimation beyond 48 hours may result in the claim being declined or settled on a non-standard basis.

9.2 In case of fire, the Insured shall immediately inform the fire brigade. In the case of burglary, theft or malicious damage, the Insured shall immediately lodge a First Information Report with the local police station and inform the Insurer.

9.3 The Insured shall take all steps to minimise the loss, preserve the damaged property for the inspection of the surveyor, and shall not dispose of any damaged item without the written consent of the Insurer.

9.4 The Insured shall submit the claim form, within fifteen (15) days of the date of loss, along with the following documents: (i) fire brigade report or the FIR copy; (ii) copies of the invoices, stock statements, and the stock register as on the date of loss; (iii) estimate of repairs or replacement from an authorised dealer; (iv) photographs of the damaged property; and (v) any other document requested by the surveyor.

9.5 The surveyor appointed by the Insurer shall submit the report within thirty (30) days of the receipt of all documents. The Insurer shall settle the claim within thirty (30) days of the receipt of the surveyor's final report, in accordance with the IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders' Interests) Regulations, 2017, and shall pay interest at 2% above the bank rate for any delay.

10. CONDITIONS, WARRANTIES AND SPECIAL CLAUSES

10.1 Average Clause: If the sum insured on any item is less than 85% of the value of the property at the time of the loss, the claim shall be reduced in the proportion that the sum insured bears to the value.

10.2 Warranty: The Insured warrants that the fire extinguishers and hydrant system will be maintained in good working order, and the fire licence of the Insured will remain valid throughout the policy period (Fire NOC valid till 31 March 2027).

10.3 Warranty for burglary: The Insured warrants that the premises will be protected by a security guard from 7:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., and by a CCTV system of 16 cameras with 30 days' backup, and that the main warehouse will be secured with a steel shutter and two padlocks.

10.4 Cancellation: The policy may be cancelled by the Insured by giving fifteen (15) days' notice, in which case the Insurer shall retain the premium at short period rates. The Insurer may cancel the policy by giving seven (7) days' notice by registered post to the Insured.

10.5 Disclosure: The Insured shall promptly inform the Insurer of any change in the risk, including any alteration in construction, occupancy, or the stock levels, which would increase the risk.

10.6 Hypothecation: The interest of Narmada Commercial Bank Limited, Alkapuri Branch, Vadodara, as the hypothecatee, is noted on the Stock and Plant and machinery, to the extent of its interest.

10.7 Grievances: The Insured may approach the Grievance Redressal Officer of the Insurer, and thereafter the Insurance Ombudsman, Ahmedabad, in accordance with the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.

11. RENEWAL

11.1 The policy is due for renewal on 9 January 2027. The Insurer shall send a renewal notice at least thirty (30) days before the due date. A grace period is not allowed for fire policies, and any loss occurring after the expiry date will not be covered.
